initiative.title: Port the playtest to openagents.com, ready for the owner to switch
initiative.body: Everything playtest.openagents.com runs today (the Kiki flow on the aethyr-demo Cloud Run service) rebuilt in this repo, in Coax, on openagents.com, with its data in Cloud SQL and full analytics for admins. playtest.openagents.com is not switched until the owner's final review.

milestones.title: The playtest flow in Coax
milestones.body: Kiki's flow, rebuilt in Coax on openagents.com: the landing, the galaxy and the Haunted House with its quest, edit mode, characters and saving. Served at openagents.com/playtest until the owner switches playtest.openagents.com.

milestones.title: The playtest server
milestones.body: Everything the Python API in the demo does (aethyr-cpp tools/serve.py and friends): players by email (never verified) or as guests, saves, published worlds, character chat, feedback and the session recording, as a Coax/C service on Cloud Run with its data in Cloud SQL.

milestones.title: Full analytics and the admin dashboard
milestones.body: Every kind of data the playtest records, and everything traffic can tell us, captured on openagents.com into Cloud SQL; a Coax-drawn dashboard for admins, signed in with their phone (Nostr), no WorkOS.

milestones.title: Frozen demos and golden checks
milestones.body: A demo is one exact build that never changes until the owner moves its pin: named releases, golden screenshots of the Haunted House, page smokes, the share card.

milestones.title: Ready to switch playtest.openagents.com
milestones.body: Everything needed to point playtest.openagents.com at the new system, staged and rehearsed, with the old demo's data carried over; the owner does the final review and says when.

tasks.title: Inventory the playtest: every page, endpoint, event and file
tasks.body: Read the aethyr-cpp repo (~/work/aethyr-cpp, OpenAgentsInc/aethyr-cpp): the pinned playtest flow is frozen/kiki/ (frozen/kiki.pin), and the live demo runs its demo/kiki-* tag (the worktree ~/work/aethyr-demo is that checkout; read, never edit it): README 'The web root', docs/environments.md, docs/kiki-playtest-2026-10-25.md, docs/owner-decisions.md, tools/serve.py and every tool it imports, tools/analytics.py, web/analytics.js, web/kiki pages, frozen/kiki. Write docs/verse/playtest-port.md: each page and what it does, each /api endpoint with request and response, each recorded event and field, each stored file and bucket, the Cloud Run, load balancer, DNS and certificate setup, and what in openagents already covers it (/realm/haunted-house). Split or add queue tasks where this inventory finds work the queue misses.
acceptance: docs/verse/playtest-port.md lists every page, endpoint, event and stored file with its source path
Every gap found is a task on this project

tasks.body: The demo's landing (revision 8): the title, the email box (never verified) with Enter beside it, and playing first as a guest who is asked once later. Drawn in Coax with the HUD look, at openagents.com/playtest on staging. Typed text uses the HUD field host.js already provides.
acceptance: Real-Chrome screenshots, desktop and phone, side by side with the demo's
Email and guest both reach the galaxy; the email is stored by the server

tasks.body:
The demo's galaxy after the landing, with the Haunted House the only world that opens (others shown, closed), in Coax.

Needed by Planetary Villa (https://openagents.com/projects/planetary-villa): pv-galaxy-entry.
acceptance: Screenshots match the demo's layout; tapping the Haunted House opens /realm/haunted-house in the flow

acceptance: The quest completes end to end in Chrome; a #test drives it headless

Edits survive a reload (with pt-saves)

Teaching persists for that world

World data and progress saved as versioned snapshots with a CRC (aethyr-cpp docs/save.md): IndexedDB in the page, the server for players with an email, fallback to the last good save, migrations forward.

Needed by Planetary Villa (https://openagents.com/projects/planetary-villa): hc-tombstones, hc-vase-place.
acceptance: A corrupted save falls back to the last good one (#test)
Progress follows a player with an email to another browser

tasks.title: The playtest service: Coax/C on Cloud Run, Cloud SQL behind it
tasks.body: A native Coax service (coax/web/serve.c is the starting point) on Cloud Run, reached at openagents.com/api/playtest/* through the load balancer on staging, talking to a database on an existing Cloud SQL instance (pick openagents-production-pg or another, within the $1,500 a month budget, and say why). Schema migrations in the repo.
acceptance: Staging answers /api/playtest/health from Cloud Run with a database round trip
No new Cloud SQL instance unless the inventory shows one is needed

Every player and world endpoint the demo has, with the same behavior: join by email (never verified) or as a guest, save and load, publish a world and open it by link.

Needed by Planetary Villa (https://openagents.com/projects/planetary-villa): hc-pet-upload.
acceptance: Each demo endpoint has a test against the new service
The page flow works against staging

tasks.title: Character chat on the server

acceptance: Same questions give comparable answers to the demo's (a side-by-side transcript)

tasks.title: Feedback from players

acceptance: Feedback posted in the flow appears in the dashboard with its session

tasks.title: Capture everything the playtest records, and all the traffic
tasks.body: Every event and field from tools/analytics.py and web/analytics.js (owner decision 4.2: save everything), on every openagents.com page, not only the playtest: page views, sessions, referrers, user agent, screen, timing, input, errors, geography from the load balancer's headers, and typed and spoken text where the playtest saved it, with the disclosure the demo shows. Coax collects in the page; the host only sends bytes.
acceptance: Every event type in the inventory is captured and stored
A session replays in order from the database
The disclosure shows where the demo showed it

tasks.title: The admin dashboard, drawn in Coax
tasks.body: openagents.com/admin/analytics: sessions, funnels through the flow, where players stopped, every session's timeline with what they typed and said, feedback, traffic sources, errors. Admins only: signed in with the phone (Coax project milestone 'Sign in to the website with your phone'); until that lands, an admin signs a NIP-98 request with their key from this machine. Never WorkOS.
acceptance: The owner sees yesterday's playtest sessions on staging
A non-admin gets nothing, not even counts

tasks.title: Carry the demo's recorded sessions and data over
tasks.body: Import everything in the bucket aethyr-demo-data (players, worlds, saves, sessions, feedback) into the new database, idempotently, without changing the demo's bucket. Never delete anything Verse, Aethyr or playtest.
acceptance: Counts match source and destination
Re-running changes nothing

tasks.title: Pinned demo releases: one exact build until the owner moves it
tasks.body: A demo is a named, never-moved git tag released by coax/web/release.sh to its own path and bucket prefix, independent of main's releases; moving the pin is an owner step. Mirrors docs/environments.md's demo rules in the new system.
acceptance: Releasing main never changes the pinned demo
Moving the pin and rolling it back are each one command

The smoke walks landing to Haunted House on staging

tasks.title: The switch-over plan and rehearsal for playtest.openagents.com
tasks.body: Today playtest.openagents.com is a load balancer in front of Cloud Run aethyr-demo. Write and rehearse the switch: the new host rule and certificate on the Coaxial load balancer, data freeze and last import, the exact DNS or URL-map change, smoke checks, and the one-command rollback to aethyr-demo. Rehearse on a staging hostname. Don't switch.
acceptance: The rehearsal on a staging hostname passes its smokes
The rollback is tested
Nothing about playtest.openagents.com changes

tasks.title: Side-by-side parity review for the owner
tasks.body: A checklist with links: each demo page and feature next to its new version, with screenshots, known differences and the data counts. Add the owner's review and go/no-go to NEEDS_OWNER.md (committed and pushed to the workspace repo). The owner decides when to switch.
acceptance: The checklist covers every inventory item
NEEDS_OWNER.md names the review screen by screen

tasks.title: The analytics contract checked at every release
tasks.body: Reference: docs/verse/playtest-port.md (the inventory) and ~/work/aethyr-cpp (frozen/kiki/); ~/work/aethyr-demo is read-only. coax/web/release.sh plays /realm/haunted-house on staging in headless Chrome (coax/web/shot.ts style driver, never a visible window) and refuses to promote a build that stops sending any contract event (session-start, page-view, world-enter, load-engine, area, objective, quest, click, world-leave). The dashboard gains a Health card: per surface, last event, last hour and day, and contract events missing. INVARIANTS.md: 'Analytics never lose visibility'.
acceptance: A staging build with one contract event removed is refused before promote, with the missing event named
The Health card on /admin/analytics shows last event per surface and flags a missing contract event
A normal release still promotes and the journey check adds under 10 s

Presence and chat events reach analytics

tasks.title: Tie a session to a Nostr identity
tasks.body: Reference: docs/verse/playtest-port.md (the inventory) and ~/work/aethyr-cpp (frozen/kiki/); ~/work/aethyr-demo is read-only. Once the Coax project's phone sign-in lands (web-sign-in-page, server-nip98-session), a playtest session and its saves attach to the signed-in Nostr pubkey; guests stay first-class and can claim their guest saves on sign-in. The playtest used Google, GitHub and email; openagents.com uses Nostr only, never WorkOS. The analytics schema already has the column.
acceptance: Signing in moves a guest's saves and sessions to the pubkey
Signed-out play is unchanged
Analytics sessions carry the pubkey after sign-in
